generator_cmd: plain="$plain" PYTHONPATH=pycipher-0.5.2 python3 -c "import sys,os,pycipher as P;p=os.environ['plain'];c=iter(P.SimpleSubstitution('QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBNM').encipher(p) if 'e'=='e' else P.SimpleSubstitution('QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBNM').decipher(p));print(''.join((lambda x:x if ch.isupper() else x.lower())(next(c)) if ch.isalpha() else ch for ch in p))"  # monoalphabetic substitution (QWERTY key): same shape, no periodic/progressive/autokey key stream
